adapters: GetCurrentDirectoryA supplies controlled ASCII project roots; actual cwd retrieval and failure/length limits not executed.
GetFileAttributesA supplied controlled missing/file/directory masks; actual project marker existence/type separately queried with host filesystem.
Standard string assignment/free, lowercase transform and strstr adapted; original score branches, query ordering, weighting and mode comparison/tie handling execute.
Security cookie adapted; native image/data and original instruction paths remain unchanged.
limits: ASCII path/layout classification scope; other encodings, real cwd failures, other Windows attribute bits and process-global concurrency remain open.
Classifier is not the full configuration cache, localized filename branch, UI/persistence or whole-game completion proof.
